title: ApiReturnedPolicyRefresh lacks the demo guard its sibling ApiReturnedSession just got — an in-flight /me response landing after demo entry overwrites demo auth/csrf with the real landlord's
detail: The visibility listener (installed on any non-demo boot) fires check_session; if that response lands after in-session demo entry, the Ok arm installs the REAL landlord, REAL csrf_token and real server_policy_version into the demo model — arming the latent policy modal and any unintercepted write. The Error(401) arm calls handle_session_lost, bouncing the demo user to /login mid-demo.
recommended_fix: Add the same 'case model.demo_mode { True -> #(model, effect.none()) }' guard to ApiReturnedPolicyRefresh that ApiReturnedSession received.

title: BrowserChangedUrl dispatch never consults is_demo_route — browser Back to a demo deep link (/vacancies/v-*) after demo exit fires real API calls with fixture ids
detail: Exit demo via the banner CTA to /signup, press Back: the URL is /vacancies/v-maples, demo_mode is False, so the VacancyDetail arm issues real vacancy_api.get_detail("v-maples") + fetch_leaderboard — 401/404s against the real API, contradicting the boot path where the same URL re-enters the demo via is_demo_route.
recommended_fix: In the '_, False' arm, re-enter the demo when is_demo_route(route) is True (mirror the init boot decision) instead of running handle_browser_change.

title: still present since round 3: Demo exit via the banner CTA from a dirty edit page — demo state is cleared first, then the unsaved-changes guard fires against the cleared state
detail: Dirty demo edit page → banner CTA to /signup: clear_demo_state runs first (demo_mode False, store None), then the guard sees vacancy_edit_has_unsaved_changes True, shows the prompt and modem.replace's back to /vacancies/<demo-id>/edit. 'Keep editing' lands on the real edit page for a fixture id with demo_mode False — a save fires vacancy_api.update_vacancy with the bogus demo csrf.
recommended_fix: Run the dirty-edit guard before clearing demo state, or have clear_demo_state also reset vacancy_edit_has_unsaved_changes/show_unsaved_changes_prompt/unsaved_changes_destination.

title: still present since round 3: entering demo clobbers a live landlord session; exit downgrades auth to NotAsked
evidence:
enter_demo: 'Model(
          ..model,
          route:,
          auth: Success(landlord),
          csrf_token: "demo-csrf-token",
          demo_mode: True,' — clear_demo_state: 'demo_mode: False,
    demo_store: None,
    auth: NotAsked,'
detail: A logged-in landlord who opens /demo has auth overwritten by the mock landlord; on exit auth is NotAsked even though their session cookie is intact — the SPA treats them as logged out until a fresh /me, and nothing restores the pre-demo auth.
recommended_fix: Preserve the pre-demo auth/csrf on entry and restore on exit (or re-check session on exit) instead of overwriting and discarding.

title: still present since round 3: latent policy re-acceptance modal can surface in demo and fire a real accept_policy POST — UserAcceptedPolicy is still unintercepted
detail: Latent on a demo boot (server_policy_version is "" so the modal stays closed), but the unguarded ApiReturnedPolicyRefresh path can now arm it with a real server version mid-demo; accepting then POSTs to the real endpoint.
recommended_fix: Intercept UserAcceptedPolicy in demo_update.handle (no-op or toast), keeping the lint manifest honest.

title: still present since round 3: deep-link demo boots fire only demo_entry; per-surface analytics undercount the primary entry path
detail: A fresh boot into /vacancies/v-maples counts demo_entry but not demo_vacancy_open, while the identical in-session navigation counts both — shared-URL entries are undercounted.
recommended_fix: Fire the matching surface event in each demo_entry_effects route arm.

title: still present since round 3: Comparison deep link passes persisted real session-storage ids into the demo store and skips the navigation path's empty-ids guard
detail: A real landlord's persisted comparison ids (real UUIDs, or []) are looked up in the demo store on boot; the boot path and the in-session path disagree, and the demo comparison page lands empty.
recommended_fix: Mirror the empty-ids guard in demo_entry_effects and prefer fixture ids (or no fetch) in demo.

title: still present since round 3: failed demo seed desyncs model.route from the browser URL
evidence:
Error(_) -> #(
      Model(..model, route: routes.Landing, demo_mode: False, demo_store: None),
      effect.none(),
    )
detail: On seed failure the address bar stays /demo (or a demo deep link) while Landing renders; no navigation effect, no feedback, no session check.
recommended_fix: Return modem.replace("/", None, None) so the rendered route matches the URL.

title: still present since round 3: edit deep-link boot renders the empty editable form for the first frame — enter_demo never sets vacancy_edit_loading
detail: The get_for_edit payload lands (r2-B4 fixed), but vacancy_edit_loading stays False so the first frame shows the empty form instead of the skeleton.
recommended_fix: Set vacancy_edit_loading: True in enter_demo when the boot route is VacancyEdit.

title: still present since round 3: demo comparison toggles and sweep-nudge dismissals write to real web storage
detail: Demo interactions persist demo applicant ids into the real product's storage keys (and demo vacancy changes wipe a real landlord's persisted comparison selection via save_comparison_ids([])); a demo → signup path hydrates real screens with demo ids.
recommended_fix: Namespace demo storage keys or skip persistence while demo_mode is True.

title: still present since round 3: unreachable routes.Demo arm in view_protected_page duplicates the demo render
detail: The r3 fix added the explanatory comment but kept the duplicate arm; it can never fire because view_page matches routes.Demo first (line 6566).
recommended_fix: Fold into the Dashboard arm ('routes.Demo | routes.Dashboard -> dashboard.view_dashboard(model)') with the comment.

title: still present since round 3 (partial): download_timeout remains duplicated with divergent signatures; store_of is now single-home
detail: demo_store_of now delegates to demo_update.store_of (single home, fixed), but the two download_timeout variants persist with different arities and a hardcoded 90_000 in the demo copy.
recommended_fix: Lift download_timeout to a shared demo helper module alongside store_of.

title: still present since round 3: demo boot skips the visibility-refresh listener and localStorage hydrations for the page lifetime
detail: On a demo-first boot the boot-time hydrations (dismissed sweep nudges, refcheck explainer dismissal) never run and the visibility listener is never installed for the whole page lifetime.
recommended_fix: Install the listener and run the hydrations on demo entry too, or document the divergence.

title: save_refcheck_edit's new demo branch is unreachable — demo_update.handle intercepts UserSavedRefcheckEdit totally before update_inner ever runs
detail: When demo_mode is True the message is fully consumed by demo_update (which now validates and applies the typed trio itself), so the carefully validated demo branch in client.gleam's save_refcheck_edit can never execute — two divergent copies of the same mutation.
recommended_fix: Delete the dead demo branch from save_refcheck_edit (or stop intercepting in demo_update and let the validated client.gleam path run) — keep exactly one.
